# braidworks demo

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Run example queries offline, on samples bundled with the sources. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/index.md).

```text
usage: braidworks demo [-h] [--list] [--format {human,csv,tsv,json,jsonl}] [--serve] [--port PORT]
                       [--no-open]
                       [name]

Run example queries offline, on samples bundled with the sources.

positional arguments:
  name                  one demo to run (default: all; see --list).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --list                list the demos and exit.
  --format {human,csv,tsv,json,jsonl}
                        output format, as for `get` (default: human).
  --serve               open the browser on the same sample data.
  --port PORT           port for --serve (default: 8765).
  --no-open             with --serve, do not open a browser.

examples:
  braidworks demo
  braidworks demo proteins --format csv
  braidworks demo --serve
```
